title: Prioritization matrix: SDK localization, streaming ergonomics, and enterprise auth patterns
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Context: We continue to receive disjointed customer asks related to client libraries: (1) first-class streaming ergonomics for low-latency responses in mobile and edge clients, (2) language-localized SDKs / i18n support for non-English developer docs and error messages, and (3) standardized enterprise auth patterns (SSO token flows, service account + key rotation, and delegated auth for multi-tenant orgs). Problem: without a consistent intake rubric we over-index on simple language ports and delay high-risk enterprise auth work or streaming ergonomics that materially affect SLA and cost. Goal: produce a reproducible prioritization matrix and recommended roadmap that balances adoption, security risk, implementation effort, and platform-level SLA impact so PM/Eng/Design can make deterministic decisions on which SDK requests to accept, schedule, or decline.
acceptance_criteria: A 5-factor prioritization rubric exists (adoption potential, security exposure, SLA/regulatory impact, engineering effort, strategic alignment) with clear scoring guidance and weightings.
A ranked backlog (top 12 SDK requests) generated from existing intake tickets and sales/SE signals, with one page of justification per item.
Decision rules documented (e.g., any item scoring >=8 automatically prioritized for next cycle; any item scoring <4 declined with templated response).

Annotated examples for three representative asks: (a) Japanese-localized Python SDK + docs, (b) streaming-first Swift client for iOS with prefetching and reconnect semantics, (c) enterprise delegated OAuth flow for SAML-backed orgs — including expected engineering changes and security review notes.
Stakeholder alignment: sign-off from Eng lead (runtime), Design lead, and two AE/SE stakeholders by due_date.
updates: 2025-02-18 Aisha Kapoor created ticket and captured initial customer asks from AE backlog (10 items).

2025-03-03 PM review: assembled matrix, applied weights, and produced top 12 ranked items. Prep for stakeholder review on 2025-03-05.
2025-03-03 Note: added 'localization' to labels after translation requests from two EU customers.
next_steps: Run stakeholder scoring session (2025-03-05) with Eng/Design/Sales/AE and capture final weights.
Convert top 3 items into scoped tickets with eng estimates and add to next planning cycle if score >=8.
Draft decline templates and playbook for lower-scoring localization requests to surface alternatives (community contributions, docs-only support, partner-hosted SDKs).
Coordinate security review kickoff for any auth-pattern item moved to 'Planned'.
notes_for_engineering: ENG impacts likely: runtime API changes to support streaming reconnect semantics, additions to token rotation hooks for service accounts, and small i18n layers in client error payloads.
Estimate dependencies: ENG-22901 (runtime-streaming-shim) must land before shipping streaming-first SDKs.
Prefer feature flags and opt-in preview releases for high-risk enterprise auth changes.
